# dsh-model-accordion
**English** · 简体中文

> Collapse the DeepSeek Harness model list into **one clickable label per provider**.
> Click `Qoder
` and only Qoder's models appear — every other provider folds away.

If you have a dozen providers and a few hundred models, the stock picker is one
endless scroll. This

plugin turns each provider into a single row: you see the
provider names, the model count, and noth
ing else until you ask for it.
Works in **both** places the model list appears:

- the model menu next to the composer;
- the `/model` slash-command popup.
## What it looks like
| Every provider collapsed | One provider expanded | Search |
| Nine providers in 8 rows. Click a row to open it. | `Trae` open with 33 models; the rest stay fold
ed. | Typing `qwen` expands every match automatically. |

Favorites are pinned above the providers, so the two or three models you actually
use are always one

e pinned above the providers, so the two or three models you actually
use are always one click away.

Every row carries a star on its right edge: click it to bookmark the model without
selecting it, so

you can pick out several models in a single visit to the menu. The
same star appears in the `/model`
popup, where the rows are wider:
## Features
| Feature | How |

| **Accordion** | Click a provider label: it opens and every other provider closes. |
| **Collapse e

verything** | Click the open provider again, or the toolbar button. |
| **Multi-open** | `Ctrl`/`Cmd

` + click a label to toggle it without closing the others. |
| **Expand / collapse all** | Toolbar b

utton at the right end of the search row. |
| **Remembered state** | Open providers survive closing

the menu and reloading the page. |
| **Star button** | Every row has a star on its right edge; click

it to favorite the model without selecting it. |
| **Favorites** | `Shift`+click, right-click or th

e star pins a model to the `★` section; click a pinned row to select it. |
| **Favorites in the firs
t-level menu** | The short pane the composer menu opens on (`模型` / `推理等级`) lists your favorites abov

e those two cells, so a favorite is one click away instead of two. |
| **Stable favorite keys** | A
connector's rate chip (` · x0.00`) is stripped before it becomes part of a favorite key, so a promot

ion starting or ending no longer makes a favorite vanish until you switch accounts. |
| **Duplicate
names stay distinct** | When one provider ships two models under the same name (a paid and a free `D
eepseek-V4.1-Flash`, say), a favorite remembers the exact model that was starred, so clicking it nev

er selects the twin. |
| **Provider sorting** | Toolbar `↺` cycles default order → name (A→Z) → mode

l count (↓N). |
| **One-click model refresh** | Toolbar `↻` re-pulls every connector's model list in

parallel and forces the composer catalog to re-read. |
| **Account info** (0.9.0) | The unified hub
shows current account name / id / domain / region / expiry, the full account list with per-account

credits, credit totals, credit packages, check-in streak and OpenCode IP-pool state. |
| **Model lis
ts** (0.9.0) | The hub lists every model with context window, credit multiplier and reasoning/image/

new/off tags; region selector + search box + refresh button. |

## Self-contained connectors + unified settings hub

**Since 0.8.0 this is a real physical merge.** The full code of all four
connectors — WorkBuddy (5.1

7.0), Trae (4.6.12), Qoder
(`@dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder` 1.16.4) and OpenCode
(`@opencode2dsh/dsh-pl

ugin` 0.3.14) — is vendored inside this package under
`vendored/`. With the standalone bundles stopp

ed and these four hosts served by
`dsh-model-accordion`, **models, sign-in, saved config and setting

s keep working
even after you uninstall the four original connector plugins in the GUI** — the
"copy
the code into this plugin so it still works with the others uninstalled" goal.
How it is wired:

- The profile `cordis.patch.yml` gains four `- insert:` rows whose `name` is a
[该节后续省略]
### Limitation

A connector's `/models/refresh` route only **returns** the live roster into its
settings draft; it d
oes not emit `llm/adapters-updated`.

- **Trae / Qoder** now persist the discovered roster: Trae writes
`regions.<panel>.lastCatalog` thro

ugh the host's settings service (the same
path its native settings page uses) and reinstalls the run

time catalog, so
the full list survives a page reload **and a full app restart**. The hub's
`refresh

edModels` overlay is now only a same-session convenience.
- **WorkBuddy's** host-side catalog change

s only after that connector commits
a settings save — a browser plugin cannot force that republish.

For those
connectors the button does the browser-reachable maximum: warm upstream data
and force the
composer to re-read its catalog.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

1. A `MutationObserver` on `document.body` (`childList`, `subtree`) sweeps for model
lists: any elem

ent with `id$="-models"` that has `[data-menu-group]` children.
The same sweep mirrors the favorites

into the menu's first-level pane, injecting
ordinary `button[role="menuitem"]` cells in front of th

e `模型` cell and copying
its classes so they look native; they are removed as soon as the pane switch

es
to the provider list.
2. Each provider section gets `data-dsh-acc-collapsed`, and the rows of a c

ollapsed
section are hidden with CSS — no React re-render, no virtual-DOM patching.
3. Click, keydow

n and input handlers are attached per container (idempotent), and
the state is written back to `loca

lStorage`.
4. The `/model` popup uses a different markup (`div[role="option"]` rows, no
`data-provid

er-id`), so `ROW_SELECTOR` matches both shapes and the popup card is
laid out as a two-column grid t
o give the toolbar a home.
## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` and later (tested against the desktop app bundle).
- No build step:

the shipped `lib/client.js` is the browser bundle; the four
vendored packages are verbatim copies of

their published artifacts.
- Runtime deps are resolved by the `install.sh` shim into DSH's own
`~/.

dsh/profiles/node_modules` and workbuddy's bundled schemastery 3.18.4 —
no `pnpm install` of this re

odules` and workbuddy's bundled schemastery 3.18.4 —
no `pnpm install` of this repository is needed.
